headline: Russia Launches Mass Missile and Drone Strikes Across Ukraine
summary: Russian attacks involving 36 missiles and 172 drones struck multiple Ukrainian regions, leaving five regions without power and damaging a bridge in Kyiv.
why: Geopolitical military escalation directly damages critical infrastructure, disrupts economic activity, and impacts global commodity and energy markets.

impacts.name: Ukraine
impacts.why: Attacks on energy infrastructure degrade domestic power generation and disrupt commercial transport networks.
